nodes.label: robots.txt Allow-All (Laravel default)
nodes.rationale: User-agent: * with an empty Disallow permits every crawler; the file is Laravel's shipped default and has not been tailored to the app.

nodes.label: AksesKita (Laravel 13 + Vue 3 SPA)
nodes.rationale: Agent-facing project summary: one page must convey that facility data is real (1.117 OSM rows), that decisions are persisted, and which invariants may not be broken.

nodes.label: GET /api/facilities Public Facilities Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Facility data must come from the API, never from a client-side array, so the backend keeps a single source of truth.

nodes.label: Rejected Facilities Excluded From Public Query
nodes.rationale: Exclusion happens in the backend query, not the UI, so rejected rows can never leak into map, list, search, filters or detail while remaining in the database for audit; they surface only in the auth-only 'selesai' bucket.
nodes.norm_label: rejected facilities excluded from public query

nodes.label: GET /api/verification-queue Merged Queue
nodes.rationale: Merging dataset rows that still need checking with citizen submissions server-side lets both kinds of record be decided from the same page instead of two disjoint inboxes.

nodes.label: POST /api/facilities/{id}/verification
nodes.rationale: Facility decisions write only verification columns, never the eight accessibility indicators, and never mass-update statuses.

nodes.label: POST /api/submissions/{id}/decision
nodes.rationale: Submission decisions are a separate endpoint from facility decisions so the two subjects keep independent lifecycles and audit history.

nodes.label: Module-Level Singleton Composables
nodes.rationale: Deliberate singleton scope (useFacilities, useVerification, useSubmissions) so map, card list and dashboard read one array without a state-management library; useSubmissions stays write-only.

nodes.label: route.meta.layout Admin/Public Split
nodes.rationale: One codebase serves two audiences; App.vue only switches layout, so admin chrome is never duplicated per page.

nodes.label: Auth Middleware As The Real Access Gate
nodes.rationale: Hiding admin menu links is cosmetic only; access must be enforced by the auth middleware in routes/web.php, never by the frontend alone.
nodes.norm_label: auth middleware as the real access gate

nodes.label: Status Rendered As Label Plus Glyph
nodes.rationale: Colour alone fails colour-blind and screen-reader users, so every status renders label and glyph through StatusPill.
nodes.norm_label: status rendered as label plus glyph

nodes.label: Frontend/Backend Constant Sync Contract
nodes.rationale: QUEUE_BUCKETS / QUEUE_TYPES / NEEDS_VERIFICATION in meta.js must mirror VerificationQueueController::BUCKETS, submissions.type and Facility::NEEDS_VERIFICATION; drift silently breaks queue filters, so no new status may be declared inline in a component.

nodes.label: Queued Submission Delay (QueueSubmission, 60s)
nodes.rationale: 'queued' is a deliberate holding state excluded from the queue and from Submission::DECIDABLE_STATUSES; the job's failed() releases the row to 'menunggu' so submissions cannot be stranded without a worker.

nodes.label: Private Local Disk Proof Storage
nodes.rationale: Proof photos are served only through an auth-protected route because they may contain sensitive citizen-submitted imagery.

nodes.label: Facility Verification Audit (2026-10-22)
nodes.rationale: All 1.117 rows were 'pending' with verified_at, verification_method and evidence_url empty, so 'pending' genuinely means never checked; therefore no migration may mass-update statuses and name/category/address completeness is not evidence of verification.

nodes.label: SPA Fallback With /up Exclusion
nodes.rationale: routes/web.php catches every path as a SPA fallback, so /up must stay excluded or the Laravel health check stops answering.

nodes.label: Homepage Hero Crossfade Photo Slider
nodes.rationale: Six-second crossfade dims under prefers-reduced-motion; images must be local files (never hotlinked) added by dropping a file in public/images/hero and one heroSlides entry.

nodes.label: Design Tokens In resources/css/app.css
nodes.rationale: Design tokens were translated from the TemplateDesignWeb handoff into class-based CSS; Tailwind 4 is wired but there is no tailwind.config.js, so new styling belongs in app.css, not utility sprawl.

nodes.label: Only Three Accepted Verification Checks
nodes.rationale: No CI, static analysis or JS test runner exists, so php artisan test, pint --test and a successful npm run build are the only gates; a green PHP suite must not be read as frontend coverage.

nodes.label: AksesKita README
nodes.rationale: Indonesian-language project README documenting problem framing, features, schema, install path and explicit non-claims so the project is not read as verified accessibility data.

nodes.label: Eight Accessibility Indicators
nodes.rationale: Eight language-neutral keys (accessible_ramp, accessible_toilet, accessible_elevator, accessible_pedestrian_pathway, accessible_entrance, tactile_guidance_path, accessible_information_signage, accessible_parking) are reused verbatim as database columns (<key>_status / <key>_details), submission payload keys and frontend attribute keys, so approving a submission needs no vocabulary translation.

nodes.label: unknown Is Not no Principle
nodes.rationale: A facility whose toilet was never inspected must not be reported as lacking one; therefore 'unknown' never counts as available in filters and instead lowers the completeness percentage, and columns default to 'unknown'.

nodes.label: Merged Verification Queue
nodes.rationale: Server-side merge of pending/needs_repair dataset rows with citizen submissions, with per-record statistics and no JOINs, so facilities are counted once while each correction report counts as its own decision.

nodes.label: facilities:import Idempotent Importer
nodes.rationale: Idempotent by external_id, skips rows whose verification_status is not pending, never overwrites verification results, never deletes, transacts per 200 rows, and writes a per-row CSV report; re-running is the supported way to absorb dataset growth.

nodes.label: Medan OpenStreetMap Facilities Dataset (1,117 rows)
nodes.rationale: Dataset/akseskita_facilities_medan.csv is the single source of facility data (36 columns, AKS-0001-AKS-1117) and is read-only; format fixes belong in the reader so the raw source stays auditable.

nodes.label: Facility::CATEGORY_MAP
nodes.rationale: Unknown categories make the row fail and get logged in the import report rather than being guessed, so category drift is visible instead of silently mislabelled.

nodes.label: Facility Verification Status Enum
nodes.rationale: enum('pending','verified','needs_repair','rejected') separates the facility-level check from the eight indicator values; needs_repair and verification_note were added by an additive migration that changed zero rows.

nodes.label: Facility Decision Writes Verification Columns Only
nodes.rationale: Marking a facility verified records officer identity, timestamp and note but deliberately does not touch accessibility indicators, because a facility-level check is not per-indicator evidence; approving a correction also does not set the facility to verified.
nodes.norm_label: facility decision writes verification columns only

nodes.label: verification_events Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: One row per decision for either subject (submission_id or facility_id, both nullable) gives a single history table for the merged queue; renamed from submission_events when facilities became decidable.

nodes.label: Private Submission Proof Storage
nodes.rationale: Proofs live on the private local disk at storage/app/private/submission-proofs, never under public/, and are opened through a session-protected route; rows survive facility deletion via nullOnDelete while proofs cascade with their submission.

nodes.label: Queued Submission Delay (60s)
nodes.rationale: New submissions sit in 'queued' and cannot be decided until the QueueSubmission job moves them to 'menunggu', which keeps a spam burst out of the verifier's desk and blocks decision on a record the worker has not yet released.

nodes.label: Laravel Session Authentication
nodes.rationale: Cookie-based sessions with CSRF via XSRF-TOKEN rather than API tokens; the public POST /api/submissions lives in routes/web.php so guest browsers still receive session and CSRF cookies.

nodes.label: Single Admin Role Shortcut
nodes.rationale: There is no role column; 'admin' currently means 'signed in'. A role column and Gate should be added only when a second staff role (verifikator) is actually needed.

nodes.label: Missing Vue, E2E, JS Lint and CI Coverage
nodes.rationale: 53 backend tests with 359 assertions pass, but a green PHP suite must not be read as frontend coverage; Vue component tests, E2E, JS linting and CI are explicitly absent.
nodes.norm_label: missing vue, e2e, js lint and ci coverage

nodes.label: Data Completeness Percentage
nodes.rationale: Computed from indicators that are not 'unknown' so a missing check is visibly different from a bad result; 1.105 facilities sit at 0% and 12 at 40%.

nodes.label: Perlu Diperbarui Stale Data Marker (STALE_DAYS 180)
nodes.rationale: Facilities unchecked for more than 180 days are flagged in the admin table so old data is not silently treated as current; the calculation is still client-side.

nodes.label: Client-Side Category Management
nodes.rationale: Category counts and CRUD remain client-side, acknowledged as the remaining non-persisted area of the admin dashboard.

nodes.label: Hero Photo Crossfade Slider
nodes.rationale: Decorative local photos (alt="") with object-fit: cover in a 3/4 (mobile 4/5) frame, paused under prefers-reduced-motion; the facility count in .stamp still comes from /api/facilities.

nodes.label: Undetermined License
nodes.rationale: "license": "MIT" in composer.json is the Laravel skeleton default, not a license grant for this work; the two hero photos also need license clearance or replacement before publication.

nodes.label: SDG 10 and SDG 11 Linkage
nodes.rationale: Framed explicitly as conceptual only - no impact measurement, user counts or field verification may be claimed.
